title: Left exceptional mate commutes with canonical finite reduction
statement: Under the hypotheses and given transport and mate record of lem-sf-exceptional-integral-scalar-mates, for each E,n and integral finite-Tor input K, the scalar left mate followed by the finite exceptional functor applied to the canonical reduction evaluation equals canonical reduction evaluation of the integral exceptional image followed by evaluation of transport.reductionF and transport.evaluationF. Only this left comparison square is asserted; no right mate, evaluation construction, or whole-system scalar comparison is assumed or concluded.

source.place: Construction 4.1, Lemma 5.22 and Proposition 5.26; normalized reduction and exceptional mate compatibility.

proof.text: Apply the faithful finite full inclusion. Expand the canonical evaluation and d.comparison_normalized, retaining finiteReductionIso between the distinct quotient tensors. The recorded integral support identification, transport.integral_system_normalized, transport.reductionF_eq and transport.evaluation_support identify the resulting proper/open comparison with the evaluated reconstructed map. Cancel invertible scalar and left realizations. All system naturality is used before evaluating.
